title: LABEL PLATES FIT THEIR TEXT
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, where every word sits on a plate that fits it. The floating loot names, target callouts and WEAK SPOT sat on a plate a fixed 13 units tall, shorter than the letters, so the caps stuck out of the top of it. The plate is now as tall as the letters with a padding grown with the font, the item icon grows to the plate, and labels stacked over one crate step by the plate height so they no longer overlap. A stacked column of loot names is a little taller.
now: Loot names and callouts over the world now sit on a dark plate that fits the whole word.
